observations: After the NEXI app session was revoked, Quotes Hub and live public market cards loaded on the Public dashboard.

Opening the protected settings route showed Protected account / Verify your Ethereum wallet and explained that profile, KYC, security, sessions and preferences require an authenticated NEXI wallet session.
auth_boundary: The wallet provider remained connected, but the NEXI application session was revoked; provider connection was not treated as authenticated NEXI access.
evidence_boundary: No financial action, profile mutation, account switch, or new wallet signature was performed. Evidence reuses the contemporaneous session-expiry capture and its protected-state readback.
